pages.title: CADT - Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology
pages.text: CADT - Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology, CADT CADT is a leading public research and education institution in Cambodia, dedicated to accelerating a vibrant, inclusive, and sustainable digital society. Topic Highlights Digital Insights: The Future of AI for Development This publication serves as a call to action for policymakers, industry, researchers, and development partners to treat AI adoption as a strategic imperative for competitiveness and sustainable development. We have three institutes and each has mission focus on digital technologies development for Cambodia future Institute of Digital Technology (IDT) A public higher education institution specialized in digital technology providing excellent training programs to foster digital talents indispensable for the development of the digital economy and society. Institute of Digital Governance (IDG) A public higher education institution specialized in digital technology providing excellent training programs to foster digital talents indispensable for the development of the digital economy and society. (IDRI) A public higher education institution specialized in digital technology providing excellent training programs to foster digital talents indispensable for the development of the digital economy and society. Explore Our Academic Programs Undergraduate Degree (Bachelor) A 4-year program with 3 core degrees and 5 specializations, preparing students to lead and innovate in the digital age. Graduate Degree (Master) A 2-year program providing advanced and in-depth knowledge and skills in both artificial intelligence and data science, applicable in research or industrial fields. Get Support For Your Learning Journey, Learn About Scholarships Scholarships in digital technology majors cover 50–100% of tuition, with extra benefits for women students. Our groundbreaking research, meticulously guided by our Tech Transfer Office , is transformed into impactful, innovative, and market-ready products. Khmer Braille Our research focuses on developing advanced machine translation systems to convert Khmer text into Khmer Braille, enhancing accessibility for the visually impaired. Robot Sok The receptionist robot “SOK” is developed by embedding AI technologies for human machine interaction in Khmer on NAO Robot standard edition for research. Khmer Fastype Khmer Fastype is an intelligent word prediction tool designed for Microsoft Word, enabling faster and more accurate Khmer typing. Khmer TTS The research focuses on building the Khmer Text-to-Speech system with functions designed for the nature of Khmer language. Khmer ASR The research focuses on building the Khmer Automatic Speech Recognition system with functions designed for Khmer language. pages.title: President Message - Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology- CADT
pages.text: President Message President’s Message I am delighted to welcome you to the Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology (CADT). In 2020, National Institute of Posts, Telecoms & ICT (NIPTICT) was transformed into CADT. CADT aims to be a national flagship research and education institution for Digital Technology and Innovation, nurturing digital talent and innovators to drive Cambodia toward a digital society. CADT has 3 missions to accomplish: Provision of quality Higher Education and Professional Training in digital technology Research and advancement of knowledge Innovation and entrepreneurship for better academic and society services There are 3 institutes established under CADT: Institute of Digital Governance (IDG), a driving force of digital governance development in Cambodia to provide digital skill training for civil servants and promote technology transformation in government agencies. Institute of Digital Technology (IDT), a higher education institution specialized in digital technology, providing excellent training programs to foster digital innovators indispensable for the development of digital economy and society. (IDRI), a first of its kind research institute in Cambodia to conduct R&D in digital technology, to drive digital innovation and entrepreneurship in Cambodia. In order to fulfill our missions, we are committed to the following actions: Integrating leading-edge information technology into teaching, learning, research, and school management Collaborating with international universities and research institutions in joint-research to gain regional and international recognition and contribute to addressing regional and global issues Linking, through our curriculum, research to the industries to assure that our curriculum design is answering to the job market and allow us to create a partnership for R&D, innovation and services for the community. Promoting Innovation and Entrepreneurial spirit to our students to allow them to be creative talents of the next generation. Providing the best professional development and career management opportunities for our faculty and staff with special efforts on capacity building, social networking skills, and leadership. I look forward to attracting and working with the very best faculty, staff, students to build CADT and achieve its missions in scholarship, innovation, and social and economic impact. Best regards Dr. Sopheap SENG President
